headline: South African Reserve Bank Holds Repo Rate Unchanged at 7.25%
summary: The South African Reserve Bank maintained its repo rate at 7.25% in a 4-3 vote, leaving the commercial prime lending rate at 10.75%, while three members favored a 25-bps rate hike.
why: The SARB Monetary Policy Committee sets South Africa's repo rate to guide banking system interest rates and manage domestic inflation.

impacts.name: South Africa Repo Rate
impacts.why: The central bank decided to hold policy rates steady at 7.25% following a split vote.
